parsed.name: Timepix4探测器控制器
parsed.description: 用于控制 Timepix4 像素探测系统的硬件控制器，可执行偏置电源开关、快门开闭与触发配置、计时器复位与同步，并读取本地/远端/FPGA 温度、湿度、压力及风扇转速等运行状态。适用于探测器上电准备、曝光控制和实验运行监测。
parsed.description_en: A hardware controller for a Timepix4 pixel detector system. It manages the bias supply, shutter opening/closing and trigger configuration, timer reset and synchronization, and reads operating conditions such as local/remote/FPGA temperature, humidity, pressure, and fan speeds. It is used for detector preparation, exposure control, and runtime monitoring in experiments.

actions.description: 启用或禁用探测器偏置电源。
actions.description_en: Enable or disable the detector bias supply.

actions.description: 执行探测器控制器的准备流程，使系统进入可运行状态。
actions.description_en: Run the controller preparation procedure to bring the detector system into an operational state.

actions.description: 将系统内部计时器复位为零。
actions.description_en: Reset the internal system timers to zero.

actions.description: 重启并同步控制器与探测器计时器，以对齐时间戳。
actions.description_en: Restart and synchronize the controller and detector timers so timestamps are aligned.

actions.description: 立即打开探测器快门并保持开启。
actions.description_en: Immediately open the detector shutter and keep it open.

actions.description: 设置快门触发参数，包括模式、开启时长、频率、计数和延时。
actions.description_en: Configure shutter triggering parameters, including mode, open duration, frequency, count, and delay.
